Vendored libraries (loaded as classic scripts, no build step):

- gsap.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js: GSAP 3.15.0, https://gsap.com, Standard "no charge" license (https://gsap.com/standard-license)
- lenis.min.js: Lenis 1.3.26, https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis, MIT

To update, install the packages with npm and copy the same files from `node_modules/gsap/dist/` and `node_modules/lenis/dist/`.
